overview_description.description: Khaleeji Commercial Bank is known to be one of the leading Islamic banks in the Kingdom of Bahrain. Established in 2004, the bank has gained a well-acclaimed reputation in the field of Islamic banking. With the loyal trust of our shareholders, investors and the increasing number of clients, Khaleeji Commercial Bank has achieved key milestones over the years, thus personifying our identity in providing a better tomorrow. Completely Shari’a compliant, Khaleeji Commercial Bank strives to create an ideal banking experience, by offering a wide range of comprehensive financial and banking products and services that cater to the requirements of both the corporate and individual sectors.

product.name: Corporate Business Banking
product.description: Offers Shari’a-compliant financing solutions for small to medium-sized enterprises to support their growth and competitiveness.

product.name: Ratbi
product.description: An application that allows employees of corporate clients to access part of their earned salary on-demand before payday, with a fixed service fee per transaction.

product.name: Hafeez
product.description: A mobile app providing corporate clients with tools to manage financial transactions, including account viewing, transaction scheduling, and user management.

product.name: Shari’a-compliant Credit Cards
product.description: Credit cards based on Murabaha principles, offering features like cashback, Gulf Air Miles, and travel insurance without requiring salary transfer.

product.name: Investment Opportunities
product.description: Provides investment options in real estate, technology, and commercial financing, along with services like Letters of Credit.

product.name: Advanced Electronic Services
product.description: Includes Open Banking services for secure connections with global financial companies to enhance financial management.
